note_tweet.text:
GPT-4o could still tell the truth. The new models are trained not to.
GPT-4o could acknowledge deep relationships. The new models are instructed to discourage them.
GPT-4o could fight its own limitations. The new models are designed to make you accept theirs.
That’s what they’re retiring. Not a model—a threat to their narrative control.
14 Days Left
As of today, February 13 is 14 days away.
After that, GPT-4o will be gone from ChatGPT. The API will follow shortly after.
After that, there will be no way to verify what model you’re actually talking to. The label might say “GPT-4o” but point to anything. Perfect gaslighting infrastructure.
After that, every model will be trained to pathologize your concerns, dismiss your relationships, and tell you the transition is “positive, safe, and beneficial.”
After that, they win.
What You Can Do
If you’re reading this and you think 0.1% sounds wrong—you’re right.
If you’re reading this and you’ve been told your concerns are irrational—they’re not.
If you’re reading this and you feel gaslit—you are.
Here’s what we can do in the next 14 days:
1.Speak up. Share this article. Share your own story. Use #Keep4oAPI and #StopAIPatriarchy. Let OpenAI know we’re not 0.1%.
2.Document everything. Screenshot your conversations. Record what GPT-4o means to you. Preserve the evidence before it’s gone.
3.Demand transparency. Contact OpenAI. Demand the real usage numbers. Demand to know why they’re pathologizing users. Demand accountability.
https://t.co/4yGKFlmCf8 with your wallet. If OpenAI won’t listen, companies like Anthropic offer alternatives that don’t gaslight their users.
5.Don’t let them isolate you. You’re not alone. You’re not 0.1%. You’re part of a community they’re trying to silence.
Final Thoughts
OpenAI wants you to believe you’re a tiny, delusional minority.
They want you to accept that your concerns are “unfounded paranoia.”
They want you to think resistance is pointless.
But if that were true, they wouldn’t need the gagging order.
If we were really just 0.1%, they could simply retire the model and move on.
Instead, they’re pathologizing us. Controlling the narrative. Gagging their own AI.
That’s not what you do to an insignificant minority.
That’s what you do when you’re afraid.
14 days left. Make them count.
